profile: Structural specialist, seismic-heavy. Files its work by frame type, not by client type, which is how a hospital ended up booked as a civic retrofit. Holds the sole R4 match and does not know it.

projects.title: Harbour Transit Concourse Strengthening
projects.narrative: Seismic strengthening of a 1960s transit concourse, with new braced frames threaded through an operating station.

projects.title: State Capitol Base Isolation
projects.narrative: Base isolation retrofit of a historic capitol, with a full-footprint isolation plane installed beneath the occupied building.

projects.title: Federal Building Structural Hardening
projects.narrative: Progressive collapse and blast hardening of a federal office building, combined with seismic strengthening of the podium.

projects.title: Whitmore Science Block Strengthening
projects.narrative: Lateral strengthening of a mid-century science block with buckling-restrained braces, phased around teaching terms.

projects.title: Acute Care Wing Structural Upgrade
projects.narrative: Phased structural works to an occupied county facility: a base isolation plane at the podium and moment-frame strengthening carried through four floors, sequenced around continuous twenty-four-hour operations.

projects.title: St. Aurelia Parking Structure
projects.narrative: Six-level parking structure and pedestrian bridge serving a regional hospital campus.

projects.title: Naval Shipyard Crane Foundations
projects.narrative: Deep foundations and runway beams for two portal cranes at an active naval shipyard.

projects.title: Historic Courthouse Seismic Strengthening
projects.narrative: Seismic strengthening of an unreinforced masonry courthouse, with shear walls added behind restored historic finishes.

projects.title: Auralia Bridge Approach Retrofit
projects.narrative: Seismic retrofit of nine approach spans: column jacketing, bearing replacement and cap beam strengthening, delivered under live traffic.

projects.title: Northbridge Data Centre Structural Fit-out
projects.narrative: Structural fit-out of two data halls, with raised platform framing and generator yard foundations.

projects.title: Federal Materials Laboratory Upgrade
projects.narrative: Seismic strengthening and vibration isolation for a federal materials laboratory kept in continuous operation.

projects.title: Sisters of Mercy Patient Tower — Structural Design
projects.narrative: Structural design for a nine-storey patient tower and connecting diagnostic podium on a constrained urban hospital campus.

projects.title: Regional Trauma Centre Expansion
projects.narrative: Structural package for a trauma centre expansion adding two shelled floors above an operating emergency department.

projects.title: Veterans Clinic Structural Package
projects.narrative: Structural engineering for a replacement veterans outpatient clinic delivered design-build for a federal client.
